mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with varenicline (partial nicotinic receptor agonist) may increase sympathomimetic activity and risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and CNS overstimulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, initiate phenelzine at least 14 days after varenicline discontinuation or vice versa, with careful monitoring of blood pressure and neuropsychiatric symptoms.
